tasks.label: UE: Generate Project Files (VSCode)
tasks.detail: Rebuild IntelliSense + VS Code project data with UBT. Run after adding/removing modules or editing *.Build.cs / *.Target.cs / *.uplugin.

tasks.label: UE: Build WindEditor Development
tasks.detail: Incremental editor build. This is the fast verification loop for C++ changes.

tasks.label: UE: Run Automation Tests (headless)
tasks.detail: Build, then run the Unreal automation test harness with no rendering and no UI. The filter is the test-name prefix 'Wind.' -- the trailing dot matters, because bare 'Wind' also matches engine tests such as Slate.Window.* . Note that the harness exits non-zero both on test failure and when the filter matches nothing.
